note.text: Per-VM Codex configuration requirement: each project MicroVM must own a separate persistent Codex user-global configuration rather than bind-mounting, sharing, or continuously synchronizing the host Codex configuration directory. On first initialization only, the trusted setup path may copy an explicitly allowlisted and documented subset of reusable host preferences into the new VM state. It must exclude project-specific settings, repository instructions or state, session history, transcripts, caches, logs, per-project memories, and any other project-derived data. Authentication material must follow the ticket's explicit credential and first-time authentication design rather than being copied implicitly. After initialization, host and VM configurations diverge independently: changes inside the VM never mutate or synchronize back to the host, and later host changes do not silently overwrite the VM configuration. Document the source allowlist, exclusions, copy timing, destination, ownership, permissions, reset/reseed behavior, and migration behavior as Codex's config schema evolves.
